title: How Canada Geese Travel With Their Young
caption:
GOSLINGS ON THE MOVE. Separate real family scenes, from shoreline to open water. #WildVox #CanadaGeese #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: Tiny Canada goose goslings gather beside an adult, keeping their family group close.
Another family travels together in a different location, their small bodies moving alongside adults.
One gosling stops to forage among plants, exploring the ground within its reach.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Canada goose gosling foraging (Branta canadensis).webm

narration_timeline.text: Elsewhere, a family walks near the shoreline while other young goslings rest in a separate scene.
On two park waterways, older Canada geese paddle through the water in separate groups.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Canada Goose on Golden Gate Park lake.webm and Canada Geese (25738746322).webm

narration_timeline.text: A parent and gosling appear together once more, closing the journey with a familiar family sight.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic footage: Canada Geese with Gosling - Mother & Father Goose with baby - Canon FS200.webm
